polityNote: Gabonese Republic since independence 1960-08-17. The nine units were called régions (then préfectures) until c.1975, provinces since; territory unchanged.

sources.title: Gabon — fiche géographique, Archives nationales d'outre-mer (updated 2017-09-15)
sources.says: Haut-Ogooué recreated in Gabon 16 Oct 1946; at the 1958 elections the regions were these nine; independence 17 August 1960.

sources.title: Provinces of Gabon — Statoids (Gwillim Law, last updated 2016-10-06)
sources.says: Nine provinces; change history lists only capital renamings and the ~1975 prefecture-to-province status change, no transfer of territory between provinces.

spans.dateNote: The same nine units existed as régions before independence (ANOM: 1958 list); scope starts at independence. No inter-provincial transfer is recorded through 2019.
